run_issue_bonuses: run the issue_bonuses script to pay workers bonuses for a Mephisto crowdsourcing task
issue_worker_bonuses_from_interaction_sc: issue bonuses to workers based on their interaction quality scores from completed units
download_and_upload_bonus_records: download bonus records from S3, append new records, and upload back to S3
retrieve_completed_units_for_task: retrieve completed units from Mephisto database for a given task name using DataBrowser
calculate_bonus_from_stoplight_score: calculate a worker bonus amount by multiplying the stoplight interaction score by 0.30
